name: plan-guardian
description: Plan review workflow plugin with a plan-reviewer agent for rigorous plan quality checks. Non-blocking by default — Claude autonomously decides when to review, or users can trigger manually via /plan-review. v1.3.0 adds an opt-out codex review gate: a PreToolUse:ExitPlanMode hook intercepts plan-mode exits, instructs Claude to run /plan-guardian:codex-plan-review which loops `codex exec` against the plan and revises it until Codex emits NO_CONCERNS; the hook re-allows the original ExitPlanMode call only after a sha256 sentinel confirms the exact plan converged (set CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW=0 to disable).
